ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface covering approximately 80% of the visible area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and along linear scarification patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling concentrated at the far left and right distal tips. The central and medial regions consist of a contiguous low-intensity black field, interrupted by discrete, high-contrast white linear and curvilinear segments.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression visible with an estimated internal angle of 45-55 degrees; the vertex is partially obscured by high-intensity water spray/turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. A significant deep U-shaped notch is located on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in acute, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups on the extreme outer edge of the left lobe tip, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions; includes multiple parallel vertical streaks on the right lobe and several intersecting diagonal marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent large indentation/missing segment on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, and widespread white rake-mark patterns across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, nearly closed white circular/ring-shaped pixel mark is visible in the lower-central region of the right lobe.
